public.suggestedRevision:
add Nepal (BPR, EHR, HMIS): The national Health Insurance board documents benefit data of the public health insurance scheme in central data-base under openIMIS that can be queried by hospital information systems (e.g the national OpenMRS fork NidanEHR or BAHMNI) through FHIR APIs. The same system also receives and manages electronical claims from the Hospital Accounting Systems and provides aggregated data for the consumption by HMIS.
1) Parajuli S, Shrestha P, Yuh GA, Dhakal N 2025  "Driving Healthcare Transformation: openIMIS as a Catalyst for Interoperability enabling Universal HealthCoverage in Nepal", Poster Presentation, GDHF 2025, Nairobi: https://openimis.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OP/pages/5443944455
2) Dhakal R, 2023 "Case Study on Open Source Tools Used for Healthcare Systems", Thesis, University of Kathmandu: https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Rohan-Dhakal/publication/391047459_CASE_STUDY_ON_OPEN_SOURCE_TOOLS_USED_FOR_HEALTHCARE_SYSTEMS/links/6808d7b060241d5140157491/CASE-STUDY-ON-OPEN-SOURCE-TOOLS-USED-FOR-HEALTHCARE-SYSTEMS.pdf
3) Parajuli S, 2026, Webinar Presentation, AEHIN Hour 2026-08-25, https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/11GdwvRt3KugwEeOTwn_FXNDOXzvz2XEeNGXEoD5XUxE/edit?slide=id.g3f845d733eb_0_237#slide=id.g3f845d733eb_0_237, https://youtu.be/cOhv2kIbiF4?si=kSwC5jtd0iOgl63m&t=997 
4) HIB 2026, Public Dashboard of the Health Insurance Board of the Government of Nepal: https://dashboard.hib.gov.np/public/
